notes.title: Patch notes: Version 1.40
notes.content:
[b]Localization[/b]
All areas have been fully translated to English (excluding videos).

We hope you will continue to enjoy Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum.

notes.title: Patch notes: Version 1.31
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
Fixed an issue in the Ninpaku Area in which the nametag of an exhibit wouldn’t show even if you pointed at it with the laser pointer.
Fixed an issue in the Folding Screen Area in which, even if the laser pointer was pointing at an exhibit, the laser wouldn’t change color to indicate it.

Thank you for your continued support of [i]Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum[/i].

notes.title: Patch notes: Version 1.30
notes.content:
[b]New Cultural Assets[/b]
One new wooden tablet and two new earthenware vessels with ink drawings of human faces have been added to the Tohoku History Museum Area.

[b]New Feature[/b]
Advanced users can now use the trackpad or stick on the controller to change which direction they are facing (except in the Ninpaku Area).

We hope you will continue to enjoy [i]Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum[/i].

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.20
notes.content:
New area added
Tohoku History Museum area has been added.
This area exhibits many artifacts such as wooden tablets, roof tiles and earthenware excavated from the site of Taga Castle, which was an important landmark in the Tohoku region during the Heian- and Nara periods.
Information in Japanese and English is available in this area.
* The video screened in-area is currently only available in Japanese.
 
Bug fixes
Fixed a bug in the Ninpaku Area in which it became impossible to interact with anything if the Operation Instructions window was closed immediately after opening it.
Corrected information specific to Valve Index controllers in the Operation Instructions window.
 
We hope you will continue to enjoy Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum.
